title: Tomato & Lentil Soup
teaser: A filling, budget-friendly soup that mostly looks after itself on the stove.
steps: Heat oil in a pot and soften the onion and garlic for 4-5 minutes.
Add the cumin, tomatoes, lentils, and stock.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are soft.
Blend if you'd like it smooth, or leave as is. Season to taste and serve with bread.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
teaser: A comforting classic that comes together with shop-bought stock and leftover or quick-cooked chicken.

ingredients.item: cooked chicken, shredded (or 1 raw breast, sliced thin)

steps: Bring the stock to a simmer in a large pot.
Add the carrot and celery and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken (raw or cooked) and thyme, and simmer for 8-10 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Add the noodles for the last 3-4 minutes of cooking, until tender. Season and serve.

title: Creamy Broccoli & Potato Soup
teaser: Blended into velvety smoothness — good for using up an ageing head of broccoli.
steps: Heat oil in a pot and soften the onion for 4 minutes.
Add the potatoes and stock, bring to a simmer, and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the broccoli and cook for a further 8-10 minutes until everything is tender.
Blend until smooth, stir in the cream if using, and season to taste.

title: Spiced Carrot & Ginger Soup
teaser: Naturally sweet and warming, with just a handful of ingredients.
steps: Heat oil in a pot and soften the onion and ginger for 4-5 minutes.
Add the carrots, coriander, and stock.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the carrots are soft.
Blend until smooth and season to taste.

title: Chicken & Sweetcorn Chowder
teaser: A creamy, filling soup that's closer to a stew — good on a cold evening.
steps: Fry the onion in a little oil for 4 minutes.
Add the chicken and potatoes and cook for 3-4 minutes.
Pour in the stock, bring to a simmer, and cook for 15 minutes until the potatoes and chicken are cooked through.
Stir in the sweetcorn and cream, warm through, and season to taste.

title: Leek & Potato Soup
teaser: A classic, gently flavoured soup that blends into something silky with barely any effort.
steps: Heat oil in a pot and soften the onion and leeks for 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes and stock, bring to a simmer, and cook for 15-18 minutes until the potatoes are soft.
Blend until smooth, stir in the cream if using, and season to taste.
Serve with crusty bread.

title: Spicy Black Bean Soup
teaser: A store-cupboard soup that gets its kick from chilli and smoked paprika.

ingredients.item: Lime juice and chopped coriander to serve

steps: Heat oil in a pot and soften the onion and garlic for 4-5 minutes.
Add the cumin, smoked paprika, and chilli powder, and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the black beans and stock, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend partially for a thicker texture if you like, and season to taste.
Serve with a squeeze of lime and chopped coriander.
